steps.code:
# Parse the songs to archive from the file content
import re
lines = songs_file['content'].strip().split('\n')
songs_to_archive = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Format: "- Title by Artist"
        # Remove leading "- "
        song_str = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " (last occurrence)
        parts = song_str.rsplit(' by ', 1)
        if len(parts) == 2:
            title, artist = parts[0].strip(), parts[1].strip()
            songs_to_archive.append({'title': title, 'artist': artist})
print(songs_to_archive)

steps.code:
# Search for each song to get its song_id
archived_song_ids = set()
for song in songs_to_archive:
    # Search by title
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(access_token=spotify_token, query=song['title'], page_limit=20)
    # Find the song with matching artist
    found = False
    for s in results:
        artists = [a['name'] for a in s['artists']]
        if song['artist'] in artists:
            archived_song_ids.add(s['song_id'])
            found = True
            break
    if not found:
        print(f"Not found: {song['title']} by {song['artist']}")
print("Archived song IDs:", archived_song_ids)
